subject: Novaclinic private deployment commercial and support proposal
messages:
From: Iris Bolton <iris@novaclinic.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment (VPC) interest + RFP attached

Marissa / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — Novaclinic's infra and security teams want to evaluate a private deployment (VPC / on-prem) for our clinical document processing workload. Attached is our RFP with expected QPS, retention, and encryption requirements. High level asks:

- Commercial breakdown: license (per-node vs per-seat), platform fee amortization options, support tiers and SLAs.
- Any migration/onboarding credits for a first-year commit.
- Air-gapped / KMS options.

We'd like an initial pricing sketch and any constraints that would affect go-live timeline. Can you include a reference SOW and an anticipated DocuSign path if we move forward?

Thanks,
Iris Bolton
Head of Platform Integrations
Novaclinic

Attachment: Novaclinic_RFP_202606.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Iris Bolton <iris@novaclinic.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private deployment (VPC) interest + RFP attached

Hi Iris — great to hear from you, and thanks for the RFP. I've pulled together a short commercial outline for Novaclinic based on the requirements in the doc. High-level summary below; I attached a one-page outline (Novaclinic_PrivDeploy_Outline_v1.pdf).

1) Licensing models (choose one):
  - Per-node licensing: fixed nodes (GPU instances) with predictable throughput. Good for predictable QPS.
  - Per-seat (developer/user) with metered inference: lower entry price but variable unit economics as usage grows.

2) Platform fee (private control plane + management):
  - Standard: one-time onboarding + annual platform fee amortized monthly.
  - Alternative: amortize platform fee over commit term (12 / 24 / 36 months) to smooth costs.

3) Support tiers (SLA examples):
  - Standard (included): 9x5 email support, 24h P1 response
  - Premium: 24x7 support, 4h P1 response, dedicated technical AM (recommended for production clinical workloads)
  - Enterprise Gold: Premium + on-call guarantee, quarterly architecture reviews, runbook handover

4) Migration / onboarding credits:
  - For a 12-month minimum commit we can offer a one-time onboarding credit (applied to the first invoice) — typical range 10–15% of initial platform fee.
  - For 18+ month commits or material node prepay, we can widen that to 20–25% or offer a partial platform fee waiver.

5) Compliance & KMS:
  - We support customer-managed KMS and air-gapped installs; some extra engineering effort for fully air-gapped installs (timeline + cost to be scoped).

Next steps: if the licensing model above looks aligned, Ben can run a consolidated financial that shows total cost of ownership for node vs seat models, and we can draft an SOW + DocuSign-ready SOW draft.

Attaching: Novaclinic_PrivDeploy_Outline_v1.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Iris Bolton <iris@novaclinic.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novaclinic.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private deployment (VPC) interest + RFP attached

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the outline. A few clarifying points from procurement and security: 

- Platform fee: Novaclinic is sensitive to fixed platform fees in year one. Is there a way to structure a consumption-first ramp (consumption-only for 12 months) with an option to convert to per-node license after 12 months?
- Migration credits: the RFP asks for engineering hours for integration with our EHR. Can those be represented as a time-and-materials credit or a set number of migration days?
- Air-gapped: we require KMS integration and documented attestation for air-gapped deployment. Can you share a rough engineering estimate (weeks) and cost delta?

If you can turn this into a single-page commercial with a banded pricing table and an SOW outline we can circulate internally.

Iris Bolton
Head of Platform Integrations, Novaclinic

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Novaclinic concession framing

Marissa / Soojin — quick thoughts on the ask for consumption-first and platform fee sensitivity. Proposed commercial concession that balances risk and commitment: 

- Offer A (blended starter): Consumption-only for months 0–12 (standard inference per-token + infra pass-through), with a commitment to convert to per-node licensing at month 12. If conversion occurs, apply a credit equal to 25% of platform fee paid in year 1 against year 2 invoices (effectively a 25% platform fee waiver).
- Offer B (commit discount): 18-month commit on node capacity with a 20% reduction to platform fee in year 1 and a 15% discount on annual premium support for the first two years. Also include 10 days of migration engineering as a credit for integration to EHR.

Operational notes: air-gapped/KMS work typically adds ~3–6 weeks of engineering for automation and attestation depending on the network profile; estimate $35k–$60k depending on the level of manual deployment. We should confirm with Infra Eng for a tighter number.

If Soojin is okay with the support discount and migration day structuring, we can present both offers to Iris and recommend Offer B if they want price certainty.

— Ben

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Iris Bolton <iris@novaclinic.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private deployment (VPC) interest + RFP attached

Hi Iris — thanks for the follow-ups. Per our internal alignment, attached is a clear commercial that captures two pathways so Novaclinic can choose the risk posture that fits you. Below is a concise summary and next steps.

Proposal (two pathways):

Offer A — Consumption-then-convert (lower upfront risk)
- Months 0–12: Consumption-only (per-inference unit pricing)
- At conversion (by month 12): option to convert to per-node licensing. If you convert, we will apply a credit equal to 25% of the platform fees paid in year 1 to year 2 invoices (applied as an invoice credit).
- Onboarding: 5 included migration days (additional T&M at standard rates).
- KMS & air-gapped: supported; engineering estimate 3–6 weeks. Additional one-time engineering fee estimated $40k (TBD after infra intake).

Offer B — Committed node model (predictable economics)
- 18-month committed node license (signed SOW + prepay cadence)
- Year 1: 20% platform fee reduction; Support: 15% discount on Premium support for first 24 months.
- Migration: 10 included migration days (sufficient for EHR integration per our intake assumptions).
- KMS & air-gapped: included in SOW with a 4-week delivery SLA post-scope; minor additional bill for specialized attestations if required.

Common:
- DocuSign SOW draft attached: Novaclinic_SOW_Draft.docx (we'll convert to DocuSign once you indicate preferred pathway).
- HubSpot deal: DL-2027-0079 (we'll track approvals and signatures there).
- Timeline: we can start intake immediately; typical go-live 8–12 weeks after SOW signature for non-air-gapped, 12–16 weeks for air-gapped installs.

Next steps: please confirm which Offer you'd like to proceed with and whether you want us to expand the SOW to include the detailed KMS attestation scope. Once you confirm, I'll route the SOW for internal approvals and initiate a DocuSign envelope.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a call this week if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
